mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_effect_order(tenant_id,order_id,store_id,series_id,campaign_id,campaign_version,ordered_at,paid,paid_amount,refunded,discount_amount,platform_funding,merchant_funding,member_id,coupon_id,coupon_discount) VALUES(#{tenant},#{input.orderId},#{input.storeId},#{input.seriesId},#{input.campaignId},#{input.campaignVersion},#{input.orderedAt},#{input.paid},#{input.paidAmount},#{input.refunded},#{input.discountAmount},#{input.platformFunding},#{input.merchantFunding},#{input.memberId},#{input.couponId},#{input.couponDiscount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id=#{input.memberId},coupon_id=#{input.couponId},coupon_discount=#{input.couponDiscount},paid=GREATEST(paid,#{input.paid}),refunded=GREATEST(refunded,#{input.refunded}),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: WITH versions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.journey_id,e.journey_version,SHA2(CONCAT(e.journey_id,'/',e.journey_version),256) series_id, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.definition_json,'$.lifecycle.conversionWindowDays')) AS UNSIGNED),7) observation_days FROM journey_effect e JOIN journey_definition d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.journey_id=e.journey_id AND d.version=e.journey_version WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.store_id=#{store} AND e.kind='ENROLLED' AND e.created_at>=#{from} AND e.created_at<#{to} AND SHA2(CONCAT(e.journey_id,'/',e.journey_version),256)>#{after} ORDER BY series_id LIMIT #{limit} ), entries AS ( SELECT v.series_id,v.journey_id,v.journey_version,v.observation_days,e.member_id,MIN(e.created_at) entered_at FROM versions v JOIN journey_effect e ON e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.journey_id=v.journey_id AND e.journey_version=v.journey_version WHERE e.kind='ENROLLED' AND e.created_at>=#{from} AND e.created_at<#{to} GROUP BY v.series_id,v.journey_id,v.journey_version,v.observation_days,e.member_id ), cohorts AS ( SELECT series_id,COUNT(*) enrolled_members,SUM(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,observation_days,entered_at)<=#{now}) mature_members FROM entries GROUP BY series_id ), touches AS ( SELECT a.series_id,SUM(e.kind='NOTIFIED') notified,SUM(e.kind='BENEFIT_GRANTED') benefits_granted,SUM(e.kind='COUPON_GRANTED') coupons_granted FROM entries a JOIN journey_effect e ON e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.journey_id=a.journey_id AND e.journey_version=a.journey_version AND e.member_id=a.member_id AND e.created_at>=a.entered_at AND e.created_at<TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,a.observation_days,a.entered_at) GROUP BY a.series_id ), sales AS ( SELECT a.series_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) paid_members,COUNT(*) paid_orders,SUM(o.paid_amount) received,SUM(o.refunded) refunded, SUM(o.paid_amount-o.refunded) net_receipts,SUM(o.discount_amount) discount_granted,SUM(o.platform_funding) platform_funding,SUM(o.merchant_funding) merchant_funding,MAX(o.updated_at) updated_at FROM entries a JOIN marketing_effect_order o ON o.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND o.store_id=#{store} AND o.member_id=a.member_id AND o.paid=TRUE AND o.ordered_at>=a.entered_at AND o.ordered_at<TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,a.observation_days,a.entered_at) GROUP BY a.series_id ) SELECT v.series_id,v.journey_id,v.journey_version,v.observation_days,c.enrolled_members,c.mature_members, COALESCE(t.notified,0) notified,COALESCE(t.benefits_granted,0) benefits_granted,COALESCE(t.coupons_granted,0) coupons_granted, COALESCE(s.paid_members,0) paid_members,COALESCE(s.paid_orders,0) paid_orders, CAST(COALESCE(s.received,0.00) AS CHAR) received,CAST(COALESCE(s.refunded,0.00) AS CHAR) refunded,CAST(COALESCE(s.net_receipts,0.00) AS CHAR) net_receipts, CAST(COALESCE(s.discount_granted,0.00) AS CHAR) discount_granted,CAST(COALESCE(s.platform_funding,0.00) AS CHAR) platform_funding,CAST(COALESCE(s.merchant_funding,0.00) AS CHAR) merchant_funding,s.updated_at FROM versions v JOIN cohorts c ON c.series_id=v.series_id LEFT JOIN touches t ON t.series_id=v.series_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.series_id=v.series_id ORDER BY v.series_id

WITH batches AS (SELECT batch_id,issued,skipped,revoked,kept FROM automation_coupon_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND created_at>=#{from} AND created_at<#{to} AND batch_id>#{after} ORDER BY batch_id LIMIT #{limit}) SELECT b.batch_id series_id,b.batch_id,b.issued,b.skipped,b.revoked,b.kept,COUNT(o.order_id) paid_orders, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(o.paid_amount),0.00) AS CHAR) received,CAST(COALESCE(SUM(o.refunded),0.00) AS CHAR) refunded,CAST(COALESCE(SUM(o.paid_amount-o.refunded),0.00) AS CHAR) net_receipts, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(o.coupon_discount),0.00) AS CHAR) coupon_discount,MAX(o.updated_at) updated_at FROM batches b LEFT JOIN automation_coupon_recipient r ON r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.batch_id=b.batch_id LEFT JOIN marketing_effect_order o ON o.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND o.store_id=#{store} AND o.coupon_id=r.coupon_id AND o.paid=TRUE GROUP BY b.batch_id,b.issued,b.skipped,b.revoked,b.kept ORDER BY b.batch_id
